title: East Kelowna Full Day Lunch Wine Tour-Incl Tastings & Guide Grat!
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Kelowna
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready to sip, swirl, and smile on the Kelowna Wine Tour, where a short drive from downtown takes you into the heart of BC’s wine history! You'll cruise through picturesque East Kelowna orchards, with stunning Lakeshore views along the way, and stop at five of the region's most iconic wineries. Expect to taste up to 24 wines (yes, 24!), and enjoy a leisurely lunch at one of our favorite spots—though the lunch tab is on you. This Holy Sip Tour is the perfect blend of scenic beauty, tasty sips, and laid-back vibes!
